title: BetterTrident
description: BetterTrident makes your trident return to the exact hotbar slot it was thrown from — no more hunting for it in your inventory.
body:
# BetterTrident

**BetterTrident** fixes one of Minecraft's most annoying trident quirks — your trident always returning to the wrong inventory slot.

---

## How it works

When you throw your trident, BetterTrident remembers exactly which hotbar slot it came from. The moment it returns to your inventory, it goes straight back to that slot — no hunting, no reorganizing.

---

## Features

- ✅ Trident returns to its original hotbar slot
- ✅ Works with Loyalty enchantment
- ✅ Zero configuration needed
- ✅ Lightweight — no performance impact

---

*Client-side only — works on any server.*
